definition: a person who checks a company's accounts
description: In an office at night with glass towers outside the window, a young woman with long curly hair, round glasses and a cream blouse sits at a desk and checks a thick stack of printed financial accounts, circling a number with a red pen. Three young men in shirts lean over her shoulders to watch; then they straighten up, one rubs his face and one drinks from a coffee cup. She looks up, smiles and goes back to the page. Piles of papers, binders, a calculator with a paper roll and a noodle box surround her.

taps.phrase: to circle a figure in red
